university.name: Dayananda Sagar University
university.established_how: Created by an Act of the Karnataka State in 2014.
university.ownership_description: DSU's admissions page describes it as among the top private universities in Karnataka.
university.legacy: Dayananda Sagar Institutions were founded in the 1960s by the late Sri R. Dayananda Sagar (Barrister-at-Law).
university.overview: DSU has eight academic and research schools covering Engineering, Commerce and Management, Computer Applications, Design, Law, Nursing, Journalism and Mass Communication, and Basic and Health Sciences.
university.overview_note: Overview wording as published by DSU. It groups the schools differently from the programme listings in schools[*] below. When naming schools, use schools[*] and say that DSU's own overview words the grouping slightly differently.

sca.name: School of Computer Applications
sca.overview: The School of Computer Applications prepares students for careers in Information Technology. Programmes offer specialisation tracks in AI, Data Science, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing and Web and Mobile Application Development.
sca.vision: To develop innovative and skilled computer professionals through cutting-edge research, education and entrepreneurial initiatives, fostering leadership qualities to address the challenges of emerging technologies.
sca.mission_summary: Cutting-edge education and research, state-of-the-art facilities and faculty, and a curriculum updated to match industry needs.
usp: Placement cell connecting students to companies for internships and placements

facilities.classroom_features: Projectors, Wi-Fi and facilities supporting hybrid learning
facilities.library_note: The SCA page states the university library holds over 2,500 books on Computer Science and Applications, plus e-books, international journals and research papers.

placements.summary: SCA works with the university Training and Placement Cell. A Placement Industry Insight Session was held on 12 December 2025 for MCA third-semester students.
